title: A Unified Framework for Formalizing Matrix Decomposition Proofs
summary: Existence proofs for many matrix decompositions share a recursive routine: a local transformation prepares the matrix, a slice is selected, a recursive solution is obtained, and the result is lifted and transported back. Formalizing this routine uniformly in dependent type theory is difficult because recursive subproblems may change index types, and reconstruction must preserve structural predicates across block embeddings and reindexings.
